# CGS Pull Request Clearance Checklist

## Cube Method
- [ ] Mission
- [ ] Requirement
- [ ] Authority
- [ ] Execution
- [ ] Evidence
- [ ] Value

## Human Gate
- [ ] Gate 0 Registry Acceptance
- [ ] Gate 1 Requirement Authority
- [ ] Gate 2 Funding Eligibility Representation
- [ ] Gate 3 Build Authorization
- [ ] Gate 4 External Release
- [ ] Gate 5 Financial Commitment
- [ ] Gate 6 Evidence Lock
- [ ] Gate 7 L2KM Integration

## Controls
- [ ] No secrets included
- [ ] No production deployment without Gate 4 approval
- [ ] No paid API activation without Gate 5 approval
- [ ] External systems remain adapters, not authority
- [ ] Evidence record updated

CUBE-EAGLE may use SaaS. SaaS may not use CUBE-EAGLE.
